text:
Maya Singh: Heads-up everyone — all-hands this Thursday at 9:30 AM PT in main room (https://meet.redwood.ai/room-main). Agenda + slide deck here: https://notion.redwood.ai/p/summit-brief-2026. Two quick callouts: 1) brief exec update on privacy/data-retention changes, 2) short Dedicated autoscale demo from Rico. Please add any questions to the Q&A section in the doc by Wednesday EOD. :calendar:

Rico Alvarez: Demo note: I'll need the demo env warmed and the GPU instance reserved from 9:00-9:45. @ops-bot can you confirm a reservation? Also will show the new autoscale UI. :computer:

ops-bot: GPU reservation request submitted for 9:00-9:45 AM PT. Reservation ID: gpu-res-2026-03-15-17. Reminder scheduled for hosts 30m before start. :white_check_mark:

Priya Gupta: For the privacy segment, we'll be moving the default Hosted retention to 30 days, with Dedicated and Private customers able to opt for longer/shorter retention per contract. I'll add a short FAQ to the doc; pls ping me if you have customer-facing concerns.

Tom Baker: Can we include a one-slide TL;DR for CS/AE to send to customers after the all-hands? I can draft if Priya approves.

Priya Gupta: Yes please Tom — a 3-bullet FAQ slide would be perfect. Add it to the "Customer Communications" section in the deck.

Elena: Request: enable live captions + auto-transcript. Also can we hook the recording upload to the central drive and set view to company-wide? Accessibility is important.

Maya Singh: Good call Elena 10. ops-bot, can we enable captions and auto-upload transcript to Drive with company-wide view?

ops-bot: Captions enabled for meeting. Recording and transcript will be uploaded to drive://company/all-hands/ within 45 minutes after the meeting finishes. Access set to company read.

Rico Alvarez: Demo checklist posted in the doc. Note: please close Slack notifications and mute mics during the demo. Also adding a short fallback slide showing how the demo degrades to a queued rollout if autoscale fails.

Maya Singh: Incident follow-up: link to last week's S3-ish storage blip and RCA: https://status.redwood.ai/2026-03-storage-rca. Exec will summarize actions taken and ongoing mitigations.

Tom Baker: Added two Qs to the Q&A section: one about contractual SLAs and another about audit logs retention.

Priya Gupta: Added draft wording for the customer-facing email in the doc. Please don't copy externally until finalized.

Maya Singh: Final reminder: if you need to be on the speakers list (2-3 minute update), DM me by Wednesday noon. Recording will be posted and we'll pin the slides + timestamped highlights. See you Thursday. :rocket:
